mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed arc draws the occluded part of the cylinder’s lower circular rim. Right image: The dashed trace is an auxiliary arc connecting points of the circle construction.
Rationales: The feature shows the occluded part of the circular rim of a solid in the left image and represents an auxiliary arc in a plane construction in the right image. The dashed rear part of the lower ellipse of the upright cylinder. The dashed arc from B through D to A inside the circle.
